# Casdoor

> Casdoor is an open-source, UI-first Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Single Sign-On (SSO) platform written in Go. It supports OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP, MFA, RADIUS and Kerberos, includes an MCP server, and acts as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP servers and AI agents.

## The basics

- [What is Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/overview/): Casdoor is an open-source, UI-first IAM and SSO platform written in Go, supporting OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, MFA and RADIUS. See how it works.
- [Kernkonzepte](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/core-concepts/): Organisationen, Benutzer, Anwendungen und Anbieter sind die vier Objekte, aus denen jede Casdoor-Installation aufgebaut ist.
- [Den Casdoor Server installieren](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/server-installation/): Installieren Sie Casdoor aus einer vorab erstellten Binary oder aus dem Quellcode, verbinden Sie es mit einer Datenbank und melden Sie sich bei der Admin Console an.
- [Configuration reference](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/configuration/): Alle Optionen in der Casdoor-Konfigurationsdatei app.conf und wie Optionen über Umgebungsvariablen überschrieben werden.
- [Casdoor mit Docker ausführen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/try-with-docker/): Führen Sie Casdoor in einem Docker-Container aus, entweder mit dem All-in-One-Image für eine schnelle Testversion oder mit dem Standard-Image und Ihrer eigenen Datenbank.
- [Casdoor auf Kubernetes mit Helm ausführen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/try-with-helm/): Installieren Sie das Casdoor-Helm-Chart auf einem Kubernetes-Cluster, stellen Sie es über Ingress oder die Gateway API bereit und verwalten Sie die Release.
- [Admin console](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/admin-console/): Finden Sie Objekte über die Befehlspalette und wählen Sie Spalten aus oder löschen Sie mehrere Zeilen gleichzeitig auf den Listen-Seiten der Casdoor-Admin-Konsole.
- [Casdoor-API aufrufen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/public-api/): Authentifizieren Sie sich bei der Casdoor REST API mit einem Zugriffstoken, Client-Anmeldedaten, einem Zugriffsschlüssel oder einem Benutzernamen und Passwort, und rufen Sie sie aus Ihren Anwendungen und Skripten auf.
- [Tutorials aus der Community](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/basic/tutorials/): Dokumentationen anderer Produkte und Artikel von der Community, die zeigen, wie Casdoor für Single Sign-On verwendet wird.

## Comparisons

- [Casdoor vs. Alternativen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/comparison/overview/): Wie Casdoor im Vergleich zu Keycloak, Authentik, Auth0 und Logto abschneidet: Sprache, Lizenz, Protokolle, Unterstützung für AI-Agents und MCP sowie Betrieb.
- [Funktionsvergleich](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/comparison/feature-comparison/): Vergleich von Casdoor, Keycloak, ZITADEL und authentik Feature für Feature – SAML IdP, LDAP-Server, Multi-Tenancy, SCIM, Forward Auth, RADIUS, CAS, Kubernetes und Skalierung.
- [Casdoor vs. Keycloak](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-keycloak/): Ein praktischer Vergleich von Casdoor und Keycloak – Architektur, Protokolle, Anpassung, Unterstützung für KI-Agenten und MCP, Betrieb sowie Migration von Benutzern von Keycloak.
- [Casdoor vs. Authentik](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-authentik/): Vergleich zwischen Casdoor und Authentik für Self-Hosted SSO – Architektur, Flows und UI-Anpassung, Protokolle, Reverse-Proxy-Authentifizierung, Lizenzierung und Unterstützung für KI-Agenten.
- [Casdoor vs. Auth0](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-auth0/): Vergleich zwischen Casdoor und Auth0 – Open Source und Self-Hosting im Gegensatz zu einem Managed Service, Preismodell, Datenspeicherung, Anpassung sowie Unterstützung für KI-Agenten und MCP.
- [Casdoor vs. Logto](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-logto/): Vergleich von Casdoor und Logto – Sprache und Lizenz, Datenbanken, Protokolle, Mandantenfähigkeit, Enterprise-Directory-Funktionen und Authentifizierung für KI-Agenten und MCP-Server.

## LLM

- [OpenClaw](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/llm/openclaw/): Collect LLM agent traces, metrics, and logs in Casdoor using the OpenClaw observability agent.
- [MCP security](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/llm/mcp-security/): How Casdoor secures MCP deployments — OAuth 2.1 for access control and OpenTelemetry for audit and observability.

## Bereitstellung

- [Casdoor mit Docker bereitstellen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/docker/): Führen Sie Casdoor in der Produktion mit Docker oder Docker Compose aus, hinter Traefik, Nginx oder Caddy mit HTTPS.
- [Casdoor hinter Nginx bereitstellen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/nginx/): Stellen Sie Nginx vor das Casdoor-Backend als Reverse Proxy für Ihre Domain.
- [Casdoor auf Kubernetes bereitstellen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/k8s/): Stellen Sie Casdoor auf einem Kubernetes-Cluster mit dem Beispiel-Manifest bereit, veröffentlichen Sie es über Ingress und schützen Sie andere Anwendungen mit oauth2-proxy.
- [Casdoor mit dem Kubernetes Operator ausführen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/kubernetes-operator/): Installieren Sie den Casdoor Kubernetes Operator, führen Sie Casdoor-Instanzen aus einer Casdoor-Ressource aus und deklarieren Sie Organisationen und Anwendungen als Kubernetes-Ressourcen, deren Client-Anmeldedaten in Secrets landen.
- [Daten mit einer Datei initialisieren und verwalten](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/data-initialization/): Laden Sie Organisationen, Anwendungen, Benutzer und andere Objekte aus einer JSON- oder YAML-Datei in Casdoor, halten Sie sie mit der Datei synchron und exportieren Sie sie.
- [Verwalten von Casdoor mit Terraform](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/terraform/): Verwalten Sie Casdoor-Organisationen, -Anwendungen, -Benutzer, -Provider, -Zertifikate, -Rollen, -Berechtigungen und -Gruppen als Code mit dem offiziellen Terraform-Provider.
- [Frontend-Dateien auf einem CDN hosten](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/deploy-cdn/): Laden Sie das erstellte Casdoor-Frontend über einen Storage-Provider auf ein CDN hoch, damit Browser JavaScript und CSS vom CDN laden.
- [Statische Dateien in einem Intranet hosten](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/deploy-intranet/): Bereitstellung der Bilder und Logos, die Casdoor von einem öffentlichen CDN lädt, über einen Server innerhalb Ihres eigenen Netzwerks.
- [Datenbankmigration](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/db-migration/): Wie Casdoor sein Datenbankschema zwischen Versionen ändert und wann eine manuelle Migration erforderlich ist.
- [Casdoor aktualisieren](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/upgrade/): Check for a new Casdoor release in the admin console, upgrade a release binary in one click, and upgrade Docker, Helm, and source deployments.
- [Upgrade von v3 auf v4](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/upgrade-v3-to-v4/): Was sich zwischen Casdoor v3 und v4 geändert hat, welche v4-Version verwendet werden sollte, wie man upgradet und was danach überprüft werden muss.
- [Versionsinformationen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/deployment/version-info/): Wie Casdoor seine Version in Quellcode-Builds, Release-Binaries und Docker-Images ermittelt und wie man sie liest.

## Connecting to Casdoor

- [Connect an application to Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/overview/): Choose how your application signs users in with Casdoor - OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, SAML, or CAS - and whether to use an OIDC library, a Casdoor SDK, or a plugin.
- [Connect a standard OIDC client](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/oidc-client/): Point any OpenID Connect client library at the Casdoor discovery endpoint, and learn what the discovery document and the UserInfo endpoint return.
- [Sign users in with a Casdoor SDK](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/sdk/): Find the Casdoor SDK for your platform, and use a frontend SDK and a backend SDK together to sign users in, verify the access token, and call the Casdoor API.
- [Set up single sign-on](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/session/single-sign-on/): Let users sign in once and open every application of their organization without signing in again.
- [Sign users out of all applications](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/session/single-sign-out/): Sign a user out of every application of the organization at once with the SSO logout endpoint, and notify your applications so that they end their own sessions.
- [RP-initiated logout (OIDC end-session endpoint)](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/session/rp-initiated-logout/): What OpenID Connect RP-initiated logout is and how to use Casdoor's end-session endpoint - parameters, id_token_hint, post_logout_redirect_uri, what Casdoor revokes, and how it relates to back-channel logout.
- [Sign users in to a Vue application](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/vue-sdk/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Vue 2 or Vue 3 application with casdoor-vue-sdk.
- [Sign users in to an Electron app](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/electron-app/): Run the Casdoor Electron example, which signs users in through the system browser and a custom protocol, and add the same flow to your own app.
- [Sign users in to a .NET desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/dotnet-app/): Run the Casdoor .NET desktop example, which signs users in through WebView2, and add the same flow to your own app.
- [Sign users in to a .NET MAUI app](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/maui-app/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a .NET MAUI app on Android and Windows with the Casdoor.MauiOidcClient library.
- [Sign users in to a Qt desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/qt-app/): Run the Casdoor Qt example, which signs users in through Qt WebEngine and casdoor-cpp-sdk, and add the same flow to your own C++ app.
- [Sign users in to a React Native app](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mobile-sdks/react-native-app/): Run the Casdoor React Native example on iOS and Android, and add Casdoor sign-in to your own app with casdoor-react-native-sdk.
- [Manage Casdoor from the command line](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/cli/): Install the Casdoor CLI, connect it to your Casdoor instance, and manage users and groups from the terminal.
- [Plugins and middleware](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/plugin/): Official Casdoor plugins and middleware for Spring Boot, Quarkus, WordPress, Odoo, Django, Kibana, Chrome, and Terraform.
- [Benutzer in eine Chrome-Erweiterung anmelden](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/chrome-extension/): Fügen Sie einer Chrome-Erweiterung die Casdoor-Anmeldung hinzu, indem Sie die Chrome Identity API und den OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow nutzen.
- [Sign users in to a Next.js application](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/nextjs/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Next.js application with casdoor-js-sdk, and protect routes with Next.js middleware.
- [Sign users in to a Nuxt application](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/nuxt/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Nuxt application with casdoor-js-sdk, and protect routes with Nuxt middleware.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/oauth/): Reference for the OAuth 2.0 endpoints of Casdoor - every supported grant type, the hybrid flow and response modes, PKCE, resource indicators, federated credentials, DPoP, token introspection, and the UserInfo endpoint.
- [Sign in with the phone number of the device (one-click login)](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mobile-one-click/): Let a native app sign users in, or up, with the phone number of the device through the one-click login of Alibaba Cloud PNVS, without an SMS code.
- [Sign users in as guests](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/guest-auth/): Create temporary users without a username or password, and turn them into regular users later.
- [Set up Kerberos sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/kerberos/): Configure Kerberos/SPNEGO (Integrated Windows Authentication), so that users on domain-joined machines sign in to Casdoor without entering credentials.
- [Einen CAS-Client verbinden](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/cas/): Verwenden Sie Casdoor als Central Authentication Service (CAS)-Server für CAS 1.0-, 2.0- und 3.0-Clients.
- [Casdoor as an open-source SAML 2.0 identity provider (IdP)](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/saml/overview/): Use Casdoor as a free, open-source SAML 2.0 identity provider and connect any SAML service provider - the metadata URL, the reply URL and entity ID, the response binding, IdP-initiated SSO, single logout, SAML attributes, and assertion signatures.
- [Connect AWS Client VPN with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/saml/aws/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of AWS Client VPN, so that users sign in to the VPN with their Casdoor account.
- [Connect Keycloak with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/saml/keycloak/): Add Casdoor to Keycloak as a SAML 2.0 identity provider, so that users sign in to Keycloak with their Casdoor account.
- [Connect Google Workspace with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/saml/google-workspace/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of Google Workspace, so that users sign in to Google with their Casdoor account.
- [Connect Appgate SDP with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/saml/appgate/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of Appgate SDP, which receives the SAML response by POST.
- [Connect Tencent Cloud with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/saml/tencent-cloud/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of Tencent Cloud Access Management (CAM), so that users sign in to Tencent Cloud in a role.
- [MCP server overview](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/overview/): Casdoor exposes its management API as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at /api/mcp, and it can register, browse, and scan for external MCP servers.
- [MCP authentication](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authentication/): How MCP clients discover the OAuth 2.0 requirements of the Casdoor MCP server, and the ways to authenticate a request.
- [MCP tools reference](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/tools/): The tools of the Casdoor MCP server for managing applications and users, how to list and call them, and the format of the results.
- [MCP authorization and scopes](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authorization/): The OAuth 2.0 scopes that control which tools of the Casdoor MCP server a token can call, how to request them, and how to define scopes for your own MCP server.
- [Call the MCP server from Python](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/integration/): A Python example that gets an access token with scopes, initializes a session with the Casdoor MCP server, and calls tools.
- [MCP error handling](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/error-handling/): The JSON-RPC error codes of the Casdoor MCP server, with example responses.
- [MCP troubleshooting](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/troubleshooting/): Causes and fixes for common problems with the Casdoor MCP server and with MCP servers that use Casdoor as their OAuth 2.0 provider.
- [Connect Claude Desktop to the Casdoor MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-claude-desktop/): Connect Claude Desktop to the Casdoor MCP server through mcp-remote and OAuth 2.0, so that Claude can manage applications and users in Casdoor.
- [Connect Cursor to the Casdoor MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-cursor/): Connect the Cursor editor to the Casdoor MCP server with OAuth 2.0, so that the AI of Cursor can manage applications and users in Casdoor.
- [Connect ChatGPT to the Casdoor MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-chatgpt/): Add the Casdoor MCP server to ChatGPT as a custom MCP server with OAuth 2.0 - the steps in ChatGPT Plugins, client ID metadata documents and dynamic client registration, the redirect URI, sign-in, and why ChatGPT asks for permission before tool calls.
- [Set up Face ID sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/face-id/): Let users register their face in their Casdoor account and sign in by scanning it on the sign-in page.
- [Set up WebAuthn sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/webauthn/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with passkeys, fingerprint or face recognition, Windows Hello, or a security key through WebAuthn.

## Developer guide

- [Frontend-Quellcode](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/developer-guide/frontend/): Die Struktur des Casdoor-Frontend-Quellcodes im web-Verzeichnis sowie Anweisungen zum Ausführen und Erstellen.
- [Swagger-Dateien generieren](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/developer-guide/swagger/): Regenerieren Sie die Swagger-(OpenAPI-)Dateien der Casdoor-API mit dem modifizierten bee-Tool, nachdem Sie eine API hinzugefügt oder geändert haben.

## Organisationen

- [Organisationen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/overview/): An organization holds users and applications. This page describes the settings of an organization - password storage, avatars, usernames, soft deletion, and the navigation that members see.
- [Gruppen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/organization-tree/): Groups collect the users of an organization and form a tree. This page describes the properties of a group and where you manage groups.
- [Set password complexity rules](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/passwordComplexity/): Require a minimum length, mixed character classes, special characters, or no repeated characters for the passwords of an organization.
- [Encrypt passwords in transit](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/passwordObfuscator/): Make the Casdoor frontend encrypt passwords with AES or DES before it sends them to the sign-in and set-password APIs.
- [Customize the account page](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/accountCustomization/): Choose which fields the account page of an organization shows, who can view and edit each field, and how the fields are grouped into tabs.
- [Customize the theme](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/customize-theme/): Set the primary color and the border radius of the Casdoor pages for an organization or for a single application.
- [Require multi-factor authentication](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/mfa-items/): Choose which multi-factor authentication methods an organization offers, and whether each one is optional, prompted, or required.
- [Datensätze](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/organization/records/): Casdoor writes a record of every API request to its audit log. This page describes what a record contains, which organization and user it is attributed to, and how long Casdoor keeps it.

## Anwendungen

- [Anwendungen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/overview/): Eine Anwendung stellt einen Dienst dar, der Benutzer über Casdoor anmeldet. Diese Seite erklärt, was Sie auf einer Anwendung konfigurieren und wie Sie sie über die API aktualisieren.
- [Referenz der Anwendungseinstellungen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/terminology/): Referenz für jedes Feld der Anwendungs-Bearbeitungsseite in der Casdoor-Admin-Konsole, organisiert nach Tabs.
- [Erstellen und konfigurieren einer Anwendung](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/config/): Erstellen Sie eine Anwendung in Casdoor, verbinden Sie sie mit einer Organisation und legen Sie die Weiterleitungs-URL fest, damit Ihr Dienst Benutzer anmelden kann.
- [Clients dynamisch registrieren](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/dynamic-client-registration/): Ermöglichen Sie Software, sich gemäß RFC 7591 mit einer einzigen HTTP-Anfrage als OAuth 2.0-Client von Casdoor zu registrieren, und steuern Sie, wo dies erlaubt ist.
- [Anwendungskategorien](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/categories/): Die Kategorie einer Anwendung – Default für Anwendungen, bei denen sich Benutzer anmelden, Agent für Maschinen-Clients – sowie die Typen, die jede Kategorie anbietet.
- [Benutzerdefinierte Scopes definieren](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/scopes/): Definieren Sie eigene OAuth 2.0-Scopes für eine Agent-Anwendung, wie z. B. einen MCP-Server, damit Clients nur die Berechtigungen anfordern, die sie benötigen.
- [Provider zu einer Anwendung hinzufügen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/providers/): Fügen Sie Identitäts-, E-Mail-, SMS- und andere Provider zu einer Anwendung hinzu und wählen Sie für jeden aus, in welchen Situationen Casdoor ihn verwendet.
- [Anmeldemethoden auswählen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/signin-methods/): Wählen Sie aus, welche Anmeldemethoden eine Anwendung auf ihrer Anmeldeseite anbietet, wie z. B. Passwort, Bestätigungscode, Magic Link, WebAuthn und LDAP, und in welcher Reihenfolge.
- [Eine Sitzung pro Benutzer zulassen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/exclusive-signin/): Begrenzen Sie die Anzahl der aktiven Sitzungen jedes Benutzers in einer Anwendung oder in einer gesamten Organisation, sodass eine neue Anmeldung die Sitzungen auf anderen Geräten beendet.
- [Das Anmeldeformular anpassen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/signup-items-table/): Wählen Sie aus, welche Felder die Anmeldeseite einer Anwendung anzeigt, welche erforderlich sind, wie sie validiert werden und wie sich einige von ihnen verhalten.
- [Anmeldeseite anpassen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/signin-items-table/): Wählen Sie aus, welche Elemente auf der Anmeldeseite einer Anwendung angezeigt werden und wie der Link zum Zurücksetzen des Passworts, die Sprachauswahl und das Captcha funktionieren.
- [Das Aussehen der Anmeldeseite anpassen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/ui-customization/): Ändern Sie den Hintergrund, den Stil und die Position des Anmeldeformulars einer Anwendung, fügen Sie ein Seitenpanel hinzu und übertragen Sie das Design auf eine andere Casdoor-Instanz.
- [Benutzer können ihre Organisation bei der Anmeldung auswählen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/specify-login-organization/): Zeigen Sie auf der Anmeldeseite einen Organisations-Auswahlmenü oder ein Organisations-Feld an, damit Benutzer mehrerer Organisationen eine gemeinsame Anmeldeseite nutzen können.
- [Anmeldung durch Benutzer-Tags einschränken](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/tags/): Nur Benutzer mit einem passenden Tag können sich bei einer Anwendung anmelden.
- [Einen Einladungscode bei der Registrierung erforderlich machen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/invitation-code/): Erlauben Sie nur eingeladenen Benutzern die Registrierung bei einer Anwendung, indem einen gültigen Einladungscode auf der Registrierungsseite erforderlich machen.
- [Eine Anwendung zwischen Organisationen teilen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/application/shared-application/): Ermöglichen Sie Benutzern jeder Organisation, sich bei einer einzigen Anwendung anzumelden, mit einer Client-ID pro Organisation.

## Marktplatz

- [Marktplatz](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/marketplace/overview/): Install app integrations, identity provider templates and sign-in themes from the Casdoor Marketplace in one click, and uninstall them cleanly.

## MCP authorization

- [Use Casdoor as the authorization server of an MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/mcp-auth/overview/): Casdoor can be the OAuth 2.1 authorization server of your own MCP server, with dynamic client registration, PKCE, resource indicators, consent, and token validation through JWKS.
- [Set up Casdoor for your MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/mcp-auth/setup/): Configure an application, scopes, and dynamic client registration in Casdoor, and make your MCP server publish its metadata, challenge clients, and validate tokens.
- [Validate Casdoor tokens in your MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/mcp-auth/third-party-integration/): Complete MCP servers in Python, Node.js, and Go that publish Protected Resource Metadata, validate Casdoor tokens with JWKS, and enforce scopes.
- [Public MCP server registry](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/mcp-auth/mcp-registry/): The public MCP server registry at mcp.casdoor.org lists MCP servers with a web interface and a JSON API. This page explains how to use it and how to add a server.

## Berechtigungen

- [Berechtigungen](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/permission/overview/): Casdoor permissions are built on Casbin. This page explains models, policies, and adapters, and how your application checks permissions through the Casdoor API.
- [Configure a permission](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/permission/permission-configuration/): Reference for the fields of the permission edit page - the model, the adapter, the subjects, the resources and actions, and the effect.
- [Casbin APIs](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/permission/exposed-casbin-apis/): Reference for the Casbin APIs of Casdoor - enforce, batch enforce, and the lists of objects, actions, and roles of a user - which your backend calls to check permissions.
- [Adapter](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/permission/adapter/): Connect Casdoor to a database table that holds Casbin policies, and view and edit the policies in the admin console.

## Anbieter

- [Anbieter](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/overview/): Providers connect Casdoor to external services for sign-in, email, SMS, storage, payment, captcha, and more. This page lists the categories and explains who can use a provider.
- [OAuth-Provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/overview/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with an account at an external identity provider, such as Google or GitHub, and learn how Casdoor links and maps these accounts.
- [Map OAuth claims to user fields](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/user-mapping/): Fill in Casdoor user fields, such as the phone number or the job title, from the claims that an OAuth provider returns.
- [Add Google as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/google/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Google account.
- [Turn on Google One Tap](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/googleonetap/): Let users sign in on the Casdoor sign-in page with Google One Tap by setting the rule of the Google provider to One Tap.
- [Add GitHub as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/github/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their GitHub account, through the web flow or the device flow.
- [Add LinkedIn as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/linkedin/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their LinkedIn account.
- [Add Facebook as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/facebook/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Facebook account.
- [Add Sign in with Apple](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/apple/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Apple ID through Sign in with Apple.
- [Add Alipay as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/Alipay/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Alipay account, with certificate-based signing.

- [Add an OpenID Connect provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/oidc/): Connect Casdoor to any OpenID Connect identity provider by its issuer URL, and learn how Casdoor checks the ID token and reads the user claims.
- [Add a custom OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/CustomProvider/): Connect Casdoor to any OAuth 2.0 identity provider that has no built-in type, and the requests and responses that the provider must support.
- [Add Okta as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/okta/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Okta account through OpenID Connect.
- [Add Twitter as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/Twitter/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Twitter (X) account.
- [Add Weibo as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/Weibo/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Weibo account.
- [Add WeChat as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/Wechat/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with WeChat, by scanning a QR code on a PC or inside the WeChat browser on a phone.
- [Add WeCom as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/weCom/): Let users sign in to Casdoor from the WeCom client, with an internal or a third-party WeCom application.
- [Add Tencent QQ as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/Tencent/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their QQ account through QQ Connect.
- [Add Telegram as a sign-in provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/telegram/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Telegram account through the Telegram Login Widget.

- [Add Steam as a sign-in provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/Steam/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Steam account, with a Steam Web API key.
- [Add Gitee as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/gitee/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Gitee account.
- [Add GitLab as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/gitlab/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their account on GitLab.com or on a self-hosted GitLab.
- [Add Baidu as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/baidu/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Baidu account.

- [Add Lark as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/oauth/lark/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Lark (Feishu) account.

- [Send email with Resend](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/email/resend/): Use the Resend API as the email provider of Casdoor.
- [Send email through your own HTTP API](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/email/customHttp/): Connect Casdoor to any email service or webhook that accepts an HTTP request, by describing the request in a Custom HTTP Email provider.

- [Send email with Brevo](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/email/brevo/): Use the SMTP relay of Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) as the email provider of Casdoor.

- [Test email with Mailpit](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/email/mailpit/): Catch the emails of Casdoor in Mailpit, a local SMTP server for testing.
- [SMS providers](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/sms/overview/): Configure an SMS provider that sends verification codes to phone numbers, and the SMS services that Casdoor supports.
- [Send SMS with Twilio](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/sms/twilio/): Use Twilio as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Amazon SNS](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/sms/amazonSns/): Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Azure Communication Services](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/sms/acs/): Use Azure Communication Services (ACS) as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Alibaba Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/sms/alibabaCloud/): Use the SMS service of Alibaba Cloud as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Alibaba Cloud PNVS](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/sms/pnvs/): Use the Phone Number Verification Service (PNVS) of Alibaba Cloud as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS through your own HTTP API](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/sms/customHttp/): Connect Casdoor to any SMS gateway that accepts an HTTP request, by describing the request in a Custom HTTP SMS provider.
- [Notification providers](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/notification/overview/): Send messages from Casdoor to chat services and HTTP endpoints, such as Slack, Telegram, and your own webhook.
- [Send notifications to Telegram](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/notification/telegram/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a Telegram chat through a bot.
- [Send notifications to an HTTP endpoint](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/notification/customHttp/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to an HTTP endpoint of your own with a GET or POST request.
- [Send notifications to Slack](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/notification/slack/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a Slack channel through a Slack app.

- [Send notifications to Discord](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/notification/discord/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a Discord channel through a bot.
- [Send notifications to WeCom](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/notification/wecom/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a WeCom (WeChat Work) group through a group bot.
- [Storage providers](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/overview/): Configure where Casdoor stores uploaded files, such as avatars, on the local file system or in cloud object storage.
- [Store files on the local file system](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/localFileSystem/): Store uploaded files in the files directory of the Casdoor server.
- [Store files in Amazon S3](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/amazon-s3/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in an Amazon S3 bucket.
- [Store files in Azure Blob Storage](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/azure/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in a container of Azure Blob Storage.
- [Store files in Google Cloud Storage](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/google-cloudstorage/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in a Google Cloud Storage bucket with a service account.
- [Store files in MinIO](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/minio/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in MinIO or another S3-compatible object store.
- [Store files in Alibaba Cloud OSS](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/aliyun-oss/): Store uploaded files in Alibaba Cloud OSS with an AccessKey or with RAM Roles for Service Accounts (RRSA).
- [Store files in Tencent Cloud COS](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/tencentCloudCOS/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in a Tencent Cloud COS bucket.
- [Store files on a Synology NAS](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/storage/synology-nas/): Store uploaded files on a Synology NAS through its S3-compatible API.

- [Use the default captcha](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/captcha/default/): Use the built-in image captcha of Casdoor, which needs no external service.

- [Alibaba Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/idv/alibaba-cloud/): Verify users' national ID cards against government records with Alibaba Cloud ID verification as a Casdoor identity verification provider.
- [Log providers](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/log/overview/): Collect OS logs, SELinux audit events, OpenTelemetry data, and permission audit events into Casdoor Entry records.
- [Scan provider overview](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/scan/overview/): Scan networks and web targets to discover servers or security issues, e.g. for MCP or vulnerability scanning.
- [MCP Scan](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/scan/mcp/): Scan intranet address ranges to discover MCP servers.
- [Security Scan](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/scan/security/): Fingerprint web targets and report matching known vulnerabilities (CVEs).

## SaaS management

- [Übersicht](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/pricing/overview/): Use Casdoor for subscription and pricing: plans, payments, and subscriptions.

- [Shopping cart](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/products/cart/): The Casdoor shopping cart collects several products so users can buy them together in one order and one payment.
- [Zahlung](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/products/payment/): View payment records, states, and issue invoices.
- [Reihenfolge](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/products/order/): Casdoor orders record each product purchase and track it through its lifecycle, separately from the payments made for it.
- [Tarif](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/pricing/plan/): Define a plan’s features and price; plans are tied to roles and products.
- [Preisgestaltung](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/pricing/): Group one or more plans so users can sign up at different price points.
- [Abonnement](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/pricing/subscription/): Manage a user’s selected plan and application access.
- [Transaction](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/pricing/transaction/): Track payments and balance changes for users and organizations.
- [Coupon](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/pricing/coupon/): Create discount coupons and apply them to orders at checkout.

- [Use the Casdoor Authenticator app](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/how-to-connect/totp-authenticator-app/): Install Casdoor Authenticator, an open-source TOTP app for Android and iOS, connect it to Casdoor, and import accounts from other authenticator apps.

- [RADIUS MFA](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/provider/mfa/radius/): Use an external RADIUS server as an MFA provider.

- [Nginx](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/C++/Nginx/): Enable OpenID Connect single sign-on for applications proxied by NGINX Plus, using Casdoor as the identity provider.

- [Envoy](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/C++/Envoy/): Protect services behind the Envoy proxy with Casdoor single sign-on, using Envoy's OAuth2 filter and a Casdoor application.

- [Kubernetes](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/kubernetes/): Authenticate users to the Kubernetes API server with OpenID Connect, using Casdoor as the OIDC identity provider for kubectl.
- [OpenShift](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/openshift/): Configure Casdoor as an OpenID Connect identity provider for OpenShift so users sign in to the console and CLI with their Casdoor accounts.
- [BookStack](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/bookstack/): Set up Casdoor as the OAuth sign-in provider for BookStack, the open-source wiki and documentation platform.
- [Bytebase](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/Bytebase/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth2/OIDC provider for Bytebase SSO.
- [ELK](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/elk/): Put Casdoor single sign-on in front of Kibana with elk-auth-casdoor or casdoor-forward-auth, without X-Pack's paid SSO features.
- [Gitea](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/gitea/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth/OIDC provider for Gitea sign-in.
- [Grafana](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/grafana/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth provider for Grafana sign-in.
- [MinIO](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/minio/): Casdoor als Identitätsanbieter konfigurieren, um MinIO zu unterstützen
- [Traefik](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/traefik/): Protect services behind Traefik with Casdoor SSO using casdoor-forward-auth and Traefik's forwardAuth middleware.
- [Caddy](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/caddy/): Protect services behind Caddy with Casdoor SSO using casdoor-forward-auth and Caddy's forward_auth directive.
- [OAuth2 Proxy](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/oauth2-proxy/): Put OAuth2 Proxy in front of any web application with Casdoor as the OIDC provider, and let in only members of a Casdoor group or holders of a Casdoor role.
- [Portainer](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/portainer/): Configure Portainer OAuth sign-in with Casdoor as the identity provider, so users log in to Portainer with their Casdoor accounts.
- [Argo CD](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/argocd/): Sign in to the Argo CD UI and CLI with Casdoor over OpenID Connect, and grant Argo CD roles to Casdoor groups.
- [NetBird](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/netbird/): Sign in to a self-hosted NetBird server, in the dashboard and in the NetBird client, with Casdoor over OpenID Connect.
- [OpenList](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/openlist/): Sign in to OpenList, the file list program forked from AList, with Casdoor through its single sign-on settings, with Casdoor usernames as OpenList usernames.
- [SafeLine WAF](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/go/safeline/): Sign users in to the applications that SafeLine (雷池) protects, and administrators in to the SafeLine console, with Casdoor over OpenID Connect.
- [Spring Boot](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/spring-boot/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Spring Boot application with casdoor-spring-boot-starter - configuration, login redirect, callback and user info.
- [Spring Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/spring-cloud/): Add Casdoor authentication to Spring Cloud microservices, at the gateway or in individual services with casdoor-spring-boot-starter.
- [Spring Cloud Gateway](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/spring-cloud-gateway/): Authenticate requests at a Spring Cloud Gateway with Casdoor, using casdoor-spring-boot-starter in the gateway service.
- [Quarkus](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/quarkus/): Sign in to Quarkus applications with Casdoor and authorize requests with Casdoor roles and permissions using the Quarkus Casdoor Auth extension.
- [Spring Security OAuth](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/spring-security/spring-security-oauth/): Use Casdoor as the OpenID Connect provider for a Spring Security application with spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client.
- [Spring Security filter (OIDC)](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/spring-security/spring-security-filter/): Integrate Casdoor with Spring Security using OIDC.
- [Jenkins-Plugin](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/jenkins-plugin/): Install and configure the Casdoor plugin for Jenkins so users sign in to Jenkins with Casdoor single sign-on.
- [Jenkins (OIDC)](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/jenkins-oidc/): Use Casdoor as the OIDC IdP for Jenkins sign-in.
- [Via built-in SSO](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/jira2/): Connect Jira to Casdoor over OpenID Connect with Jira's built-in SSO, a free method that requires HTTPS.
- [Using the miniOrange plugin](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/jira/): Connect Jira to Casdoor over OpenID Connect with the miniOrange OAuth / OIDC SSO plugin.
- [Connecting applications with OIDC protocol - Confluence](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/Confluence/): Connect Atlassian Confluence to Casdoor with OpenID Connect so users sign in to Confluence through Casdoor single sign-on.
- [RuoYi](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/RuoYi/): Integrate Casdoor single sign-on into RuoYi-Cloud, the Spring Cloud admin framework, using the Casdoor Java SDK.
- [Pulsar manager](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/Pulsar-manager/): Enable Casdoor sign-in for Apache Pulsar Manager - configure application.yml on the back end and turn on the Casdoor switch in the front end.
- [Using Casdoor in ShenYu](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/shenyu/): Protect APIs behind the Apache ShenYu gateway with Casdoor using ShenYu's Casdoor plugin.
- [ShardingSphere](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/ShardingSphere/): Enable Casdoor sign-in for the Apache ShardingSphere ElasticJob UI, which includes built-in Casdoor support.
- [Apache IoTDB](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/iotdb/): Enable Casdoor sign-in for the Apache IoTDB Web Workbench, which includes built-in Casdoor support.
- [Apache DolphinScheduler](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/dolphinscheduler/): Enable Casdoor single sign-on for Apache DolphinScheduler, which supports Casdoor as a built-in login method.
- [FireZone](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/firezone/): Configure Firezone to use Casdoor as its OpenID Connect identity provider for user sign-in.
- [Cloud Foundry](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/CloudFoundry/): Use Casdoor as the OIDC identity provider for applications on Cloud Foundry, with step-by-step Casdoor and Cloud Foundry configuration.
- [Thingsboard](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/Thingsboard/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth 2.0 / OIDC identity provider for the ThingsBoard IoT platform, with Casdoor and ThingsBoard settings.
- [Halo](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/java/halo/): Sign in to the Halo blogging platform with Casdoor over OpenID Connect, using the custom SSO provider of the OAuth2 plugin.
- [Firebase](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/javascript/firebase/): Use Casdoor as an OpenID Connect provider in Firebase Authentication, so users of a Firebase web app sign in with Casdoor.
- [WeChat mini program](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/javascript/wechat_miniprogram/): Integrate Casdoor sign-in in a WeChat Mini Program (no OAuth redirect).
- [Immich](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/javascript/immich/): Sign in to Immich, in the browser and in the mobile apps, with Casdoor over OAuth and OpenID Connect.
- [Joplin Server](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/javascript/joplin/): Sign in to Joplin Server, in the browser and in the Joplin apps, with Casdoor as the SAML 2.0 identity provider.
- [APISIX](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/lua/apisix/): Protect APIs behind Apache APISIX with Casdoor, using either the authz-casdoor plugin or the openid-connect plugin.
- [Zabbix](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/Zabbix/): Use Casdoor as the SAML IdP for Zabbix SSO.
- [WordPress (CAS SSO)](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/WordPress/): Use Casdoor as CAS IdP for WordPress with the wp-cassify plugin.
- [Zentao](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/zentao/): Add Casdoor single sign-on to the ZenTao project management tool with the zentao-oidc module.
- [Verwendung von Casdoor als OAuth2-Server in ShowDoc](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/showdoc/): Use Casdoor as the OAuth 2.0 server for ShowDoc sign-in, the API and technical documentation platform.
- [Flarum](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/Flarum/): Add Casdoor OAuth 2.0 sign-in to a Flarum forum with the FoF Passport extension.
- [Moodle](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/Moodle/): Configure Moodle to use Casdoor as an OAuth identity provider for single sign-on.
- [Nextcloud](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/nextcloud/): Sign in to Nextcloud with Casdoor through the OpenID Connect user backend app, with Casdoor usernames as Nextcloud user IDs and Casdoor groups as Nextcloud groups.
- [Kanboard](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/php/kanboard/): Sign in to Kanboard with Casdoor over OAuth 2.0, using the OAuth2 plugin of Kanboard.
- [Proxmox VE](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/perl/proxmox/): Add Casdoor to Proxmox VE as an OpenID Connect realm, so administrators sign in to the web interface with their Casdoor account and get permissions from Casdoor groups.
- [GitLab](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/ruby/gitlab/): Configure self-managed GitLab to use Casdoor as its OpenID Connect provider for single sign-on.
- [Vaultwarden](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/rust/vaultwarden/): Sign in to Vaultwarden with Casdoor over OpenID Connect, using the SSO support built into Vaultwarden 1.35.0 and later.
- [Hasura](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/Haskell/Hasura/): Secure Hasura GraphQL Engine with JWTs issued by Casdoor - configure the Casdoor application, Hasura JWT secret and claims mapping.
- [FastAPI](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/python/FastAPI/): Add Casdoor sign-in and Casdoor permission checks to a FastAPI app with the community casbin-fastapi-decorator library.
- [JumpServer](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/python/JumpServer/): Connect the JumpServer bastion host to Casdoor over CAS so users sign in with Casdoor single sign-on.
- [Open WebUI](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/python/open-webui/): Sign in to Open WebUI with Casdoor over OpenID Connect, and sync Open WebUI groups from Casdoor groups.
- [Sentry](https://casdoor.ai/de/docs/integration/python/sentry/): Sign in to a Sentry organization with Casdoor as the SAML 2.0 identity provider, on self-hosted Sentry and on sentry.io.
